verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a financial-data API like Teller, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion endpoints, enrollment-revocation behavior or data-purge policy. The material covers only data access (balances, transactions, identity), payments, webhooks, mTLS authentication and the sandbox, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
